originals.ko: 그게 우리가 이미 ~지 않는다는 뜻은 아니야
originals.why: In 'nad ydan ni ddim yn barod', 'yn barod' can only be read as 'ready' ('that doesn't mean we're not ready'). To mean 'already' (the taught sense), it would have to follow a verb-noun, as in 'nad ydan ni ddim yn gwybod yn barod'. So the line uses the LEGO in a different sense, and as an open-ended 'already' fragment it is malformed.

topups.ko: 나는 그들에게 우리가 웨일스어로 이야기하지 않는다고 말했어

topups.why: Weakest of the six; 'dringo yno' / '거기에 올라가다' is an odd pairing, and only 5 are needed.

originals.ko: 나는 우리가 이야기하기 전에 사실을 몰랐어

originals.why: 'cynnig' here means 'offer (the facts)', but the course taught it as 제안하다 'propose/suggest'. That is the wrong sense, and '사실을 제안하다' is not natural Korean.

topups.why: Only 4 needed; the others are stronger.
Only 4 needed; long reported-speech line, lower priority.
The Korean leaves out the subject of 'dan ni angen'. Adding 우리는 next to 우리가 makes it read awkwardly, and only 4 are needed.
